target_metadata.description: Weighted influenza-like illness (wILI) percentage reported through ILINet for the week ending target_end_date, rounded to one decimal. pmf bins are labelled by their left edge; "13.0" is the open bin [13, 100]. median is computed from the pmf (see README).
Highest weekly wILI percentage of the season, rounded to one decimal. Bins as for ili perc.
MMWR week (labelled by its Saturday end date) when wILI first reaches the regional baseline for 3 consecutive weeks; "none" = no onset.
MMWR week (labelled by its Saturday end date) with the highest wILI of the season.
